_source: Guardian nameplate copy reproduced VERBATIM from ~/src/website/public/wolves/characters/characters.json (authoritative), cross-checked against the overlay strings in ~/src/website/src/data/wolves-intro-sequence.ts. The two RECAST plates are the exception and are marked as such: the owner replaced Bob Killen with Cortney Nickerson and Laura Santamaria with Orlin, and neither has an authored identity, so those plates carry the owner's own name string and nothing else. A name that is missing is omitted; a name is never invented.
_timeline: Windows come from wolves-intro-sequence.ts, which records them as frame-verified against the real embed. They are keyed to the SOURCE absolute timeline; every `at` below is that value minus the verified startOffset of 2.0s, so it lands on the trimmed segment.
_source_video: BKm0TPqeOjY - 'Destiny 2: Into the Light Cinematic', official 'Destiny 2' channel. Trimmed 2.0 -> 113.55 (111.567s), picture and Bungie's own score (format 251, Opus 127k at native 48 kHz).
_windows_verified: All six Guardian windows were frame-checked against THIS file, not assumed: t=8 purple void vortex (now Cortney, was Bob), t=20 Ward of Dawn bubble with a Titan inside (Kat), t=44 arc lightning duel (Kaslin), t=73 solar winged Guardian (now Orlin, was Laura), t=87 green Strand tendrils (Christoph), t=92 green Strand Guardian left + icy-blue crystal Guardian right (Christoph + Natali). The two recasts changed WHO is credited, never WHICH shot: the windows are untouched, so nothing here needs re-verifying against the frames.

plates.name: Cortney Nickerson
plates.note: RECAST, owner instruction (editorial pass, this session): "bob killen is replaced with cortney nickerson in the intro". The window is Bob's, unchanged (source 5 - 14.5, shortened from the frame-accurate 17.5 so Kat's plate replaces it cleanly -- explicit owner request, 2026-07-18; do NOT 'fix' this back to 17.5). NAME ONLY: Cortney has no authored Guardian identity anywhere identities are authored (~/Videos/nameplates.json, the website's characters.json, vocab/casting.yaml), so the label, subclass and title rows Bob's plate carried are OMITTED rather than inherited -- his copy is his. The chrome falls back to the default blue: `trustee` is a claim about a role nobody has authored for her. See issue #59.

plates.name: Natali Vlatko
plates.title: Shipwright of Kubernetes
plates.note: source window 89.5 - 96. Shares the `group` row with Christoph: the two ARE meant to be visible together (that is why they carry opposite `position` values), which is exactly the exemption tools/plate.py's overlap check reserves for a group row. TITLE DISCREPANCY, owner decision: a comment in wolves-intro-sequence.ts says her title line is 'Punch first, document later.' per explicit user request, while her own overlay string AND characters.json both say 'Shipwright of Kubernetes'. The two agreeing authored sources are used here; picking between two authored strings on a real colleague's card is not automatable. The live overlay also gives her plate a `raised` vertical offset, which tools/plate.py has no equivalent for -- see unresolved below.

unresolved.detail: The site cross-fades between hero shots (0.35s), places each shot by an authored contentFrame before its alpha bounds are measured, and renders the QR through `filter: invert(1)`. The burn cuts between stills instead of cross-fading, centres each shot by its alpha bounds (what centerComicHeroShot() settles on anyway), and reproduces the inverted code as published -- an inverted QR is what the site shows, so it is copied rather than corrected.

_hud_removed: The site's top-of-frame HUD nameplate is deliberately NOT burned in (owner decision, 2026-08-12: 'remove "a project to bring their stories to life", just the name plaquards'). That drops the persistent default card, the three #nova4ever glitch bursts and the closing 'Legends Sought' card -- every status row -- leaving only the six Guardian nameplates. tools/plate.py still renders `kind: "status"` and is tested, so restoring any of them is a manifest edit, not new code.
_comic: The comic title card, reproduced from `.wolves-intro-overlay-title-card` in WolvesIntroOverlay.vue: an opaque full-frame card that COVERS the cinematic for its window, cycling the authored hero shots of wolves-comic-hero-shots.ts over the MakeMeAComic QR panel and the Amber Graner quote. The site cues it at source 24 - 38; here it starts at source 24.5 (segment 22.5) so it cannot overlap Kat's plate, which the live overlay draws ON TOP of the card and tools/plate.py has no z-order for. 23 shots share the window evenly, the same slot arithmetic getComicHeroShotIndex() uses. Owner instruction, this session: "we need the 'comic book' slide with amber graner's quote covering the same area".
